title: Heatwaves: can we adapt?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What changes should cities make if extreme heat becomes much more common?
Who is most at risk during a heatwave, and why?
Should working hours change automatically during periods of dangerous heat?
Would you support spending public money on trees and shaded streets even if it reduced parking or road space?
What personal habit do people often underestimate when trying to stay safe in extreme heat?
